murals.name: 桩与螺
murals.text: Scene: a vast flooded hall deep underground, its ceiling too high to see, a flat grey-white glow hanging overhead like an overcast sky. Clear ankle-deep water covers the floor, and row after row of small roofless stone houses stand in it, walls shoulder-high, roof slabs heaped behind them; in the still water every house is reflected with its roof whole. Fallen grey beams lie half-sunk. Centre-low, in the doorway of the nearest house, stands an enormous man with dark bronze skin, short forward horns capped with brass, an empty carrying frame on his back, an uprooted dark mooring post on his shoulder, its foot crusted with dark-red crystal. An old grey reed rope tied low on the post hangs down to a slim woman with pale lilac hair coiled round her head, who is slipping its end-loop off the tip of a large white conch floating mouth-down. At that instant the water flashes sea-green, the pale ghost of the house's roof stands whole again, and five faint pale figures stand in the doorway and the water outside. A lean deer-eared man crouches at the water's edge, listening; a few small adventurers watch from farther back.
murals.light: A flat grey-white glow from the unseen ceiling over still water, broken by the sudden sea-green flash spreading from the conch; the far rows of houses fade into blue-grey.
murals.note: 画的是一根绳二幕中旬二日（第176、177行）：比亚克抱着桩一下一下晃，图恩趴在水边听桩脚的水晶裂，桩起来了，比亚克扛上肩，结朝上；茉德把绳头那个环从螺尖上褪下来，螺响了，水一下子亮成海绿，有一口气的工夫屋顶好好的，门外的水里站着三个人，屋里站着两个。第十三层的水、没顶的石屋、倒影里完好的屋顶照第169行，落梁照第171行，桩脚的暗红水晶和低低系着的苇绳、口朝下的白螺照第172、173行。比亚克、茉德、图恩的样子照各人的旅伴条。拿不准：那一口气里屋里那个深潮吹完螺把孩子推出门外、屋顶落下来（第177行）不画，只画五个人站着的淡影；跟下来的两队和让娜放在远处看。

murals.line: 共约的年月·叠好的装备
murals.name: 归还门前
murals.text: Scene: deep underground in darkness, a forest of doors: freestanding doors without walls stand at odd angles, each on its own threshold stone, all different, an oak door with a brass knocker, a tent flap in a frame, an iron grate, a plank door; a trail of iron nails leads between them. They end at a sheer grey-white wall rising and stretching out of sight. In it, centre-low, is one old wooden door with three iron bands, no handle and no keyhole, a worn threshold stone at its foot. On the stone lies a neat stack squared to its edge: four weapons at the bottom, a sword, an unstrung bow, a small hammer, a short knife; above them four coats folded square; then four packs, straps wrapped twice; on top a grey wool scarf folded in four. A tall four-armed woman with sea-blue braided hair and blue-green scales on her neck and arms has just leaned a heavy iron-capped battering ram against the wall and looks down at the stack, a lamp in one upper hand. Behind her four small companions hold lamps among the doors. Two small plain wooden tags hang from a nail beside the door.
murals.light: Warm lamplight from the adventurers' lamps falling on the stack and the old door; the grey-white wall fades upward into darkness and the door forest behind sinks into deep blue-black.
murals.note: 画的是叠好的装备三幕蝉鸣月中旬一日（第544到547行）：单子贴出去的第四十一天，万锁之钥扛着破门槌到了墙下，门槛石上叠着天边的灯四个人的全套装备，齐着石头的边，兵器横在最底下，外套叠成四方块，背包带子绕着包身缠了两圈，灰围巾叠成四折放在最上头；缇玛尝了尝风，把破门槌靠在墙脚下，说不撞了。门林照第528行，前沿那面墙和那道门照第530行，墙上钉子拴着的两块木牌（天边的灯先到、多琳在井口等）照第545行。缇玛的样子照她的旅伴条。拿不准：缇玛是深潮蛇魔，四条胳膊，下半身源稿没写成蛇（她要站门槛石、背背架），写成两条腿，也没写蛇这个词；墙上那十一道粉笔怕画成数字，没写；木牌上的字不画。

murals.line: 共约的年月·头一车三币
murals.name: 翼下之车
murals.text: Scene: a broad paved yard just outside an immense white stone wall. Behind, the wall spans the picture, pierced by a deep gate passage lit with lamps, its pillars half plain white stone, half carved with patterns; a row of white standing stones lines the gate. A bright copper strip runs through the paving, a long inspection platform laid over it, laden carts waiting at both ends. Centre-low beside the platform, a big four-mule wagon, just loaded, is starting off, three heavy iron-bound chests roped on its bed, a pot at its tail, a young halfling with straw-coloured curls and an old leather cap on the box. Low over it an iron-grey winged drake a little larger than a horse spreads its broad wings, and the wagon, the mules and the people beside it all lie in its shadow. Beside it walk a tall human-faced woman of dragon lineage, frost-blue cropped hair, iron-grey scales on her forearms, round shield and short spear; a very tall woman with dark bronze skin, flame-red hair and two short horns, carrying a long iron baker's peel; and four more small escorts. At both ends of the gate people stand looking up.
murals.light: Soft daylight under a pale hazy sky, the drake's broad shadow lying over the wagon and mules; lamps glow warm inside the gate passage; the shadows are slate blue.
murals.note: 画的是头一车三币三幕下旬八日（第895行）：三只箱子上了一辆车，三方在验货台上签了字，芬雅的飞龙铁哨飞越断门，把双翼展开在车上方，满车人和货都进了它的影子，门内门外的人一齐抬头。断门两半门柱一白一刻纹、门边那排停战碑照第885、889行，换车场当中的山铜条、横在条上的验货台、两头分停的车照第890行，长辙家的四骡大车、车尾的锅照第868行。驾车的是迈洛，押车的点了芬雅和兹拉塔，别的四个人写成四个押车的。拿不准：铁哨多大、几条腿源稿没写，只写它在星纱轨的车顶上蹲一段飞一段（第867行），我写成比马大一些的铁灰飞龙（★）；钩子说的两个王是钱上的侧影，壁画上看不出来，车上那三只箱子就是。

murals.name: 影墙缺口
murals.text: Scene: deep underground. Centre-low, a straight stone stair plunges down to the right into darkness from a flat stone platform. Behind the platform a stone balustrade hung with small plain wooden tags, and above it the rings of an empty hollow city, rooftops furred with glowing fungus. At the head of the stair stands the translucent ghost of a wall of white stone blocks, twice a man's height, with battlements; a gap in its middle opens onto the top step. In the gap stands a tall man with deep ochre skin and short brick-red hair, straight horns black-tipped like burnt flint, a long-handled stone hammer in one hand, the other arm held out; fire glows from within cracks in both horn tips. From the steps below three young people scramble up through the gap under his arm: in front a girl with mint-green hair and small gold-tipped horns, behind her a fox-eared girl with orange-red hair helping a tall straw-haired boy. On the platform behind him a young stonecutter woman with glossy black bobbed hair kneels by a standing stone bearing a plain copper plate. Far below, a dark crowd of horned, long-tailed shapes draws back down the stair.
murals.light: A grey-white dawn light that shines only inside the ghostly wall, the cold green glow of fungus from the empty city above, and two small points of fire from the cracked horn tips; the depths of the stair sink into blue-black.
murals.note: 画的是第二十层三幕上旬八日天亮（第1239、1240行）：墙里的天亮了，底下的东西往下退，头一处平台上蒂芙说上头有火，三个孩子往上跑，从塔隆胳膊底下钻过缺口，最后一个钻过去的时候他角尖裂开的缝里亮起了火，那一阵他凝了名。阶顶往下那一截石阶上浮出来的白墙、缺口正对最上面那一级照第1210行，第二十层那座空城、石栏上的木牌、阶顶的平石台照第1201、1203行，层碑那块钉着山铜牌的大石头照第1203行，卓娅在他身后照第1220、1225行，角尖一道两道的裂照第1234行。塔隆、卓娅、蒂芙的样子照各人的旅伴条，朗尼、绮露照人物第二十层的营那一条（第2398、2400行）。拿不准：朗尼前一夜叫刀划了腿、是绮露架着上来的，画上只写叫人搀着，不写伤；缺口里那个中年人的淡影整夜跟塔隆站在一处（第1238行），怕人数乱，没写；山铜牌上刻的二十不画。

notes: 头一车三币的钩子是钱上两个王的侧影，壁画上看不出来，画的是三只箱子装上车、铁哨在车上展翼、断门两头的人抬头那一下。
铁哨的大小、几条腿源稿没写，只写它在星纱轨的车顶上蹲一段飞一段，我写成比马大一些的铁灰飞龙（★），要改请主会话定。
一根绳那一口气里浮出来的旧景只画五个人站着的淡影，深潮把孩子推出门外、屋顶落下来那一下不画。
第二十层朗尼前一夜叫刀划了腿，画上只写叫人搀着；蒂芙十七岁，只是往上跑，没有伤。
龙裔几幅都写成人脸、只身上几处有鳞，没用 dragonborn 这个词，怕画成龙头人。
